name: kq-app-create-contract
display_name: App Query: Create Contract and link to Vehicle + Person
description: Call tool 'ciq_execute' with arguments: id: "<this query's id>", input_params: {vehicleID: (required) external_id of the existing Vehicle, personID: (required) external_id of the existing Person, contract_external_id: (required) external_id for the new Contract, contractNumber: (required) contract number}. Auth: X-IK-ClientKey only (_Application subject), no Bearer token, $_appId is auto-filled. Returns: the new Contract (external_id, number), the COVERS relationship to the Vehicle, and the ACCEPTED relationship from the Person.
